model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for various fine-tuned MistralV0.2 models across different specialties. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Per-specialty terms,” ordered alphabetically from “Cardio” to “Pediatrics.” The vertical axis represents “Negative log probability,” with a scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, marked with tick intervals of one unit. The bars are colored in shades of orange and blue, representing “Cardio” (orange), “Gastro” (orange), “Infect” (orange), “Neuro” (orange), “Obstetrics” (orange), and “Pediatrics” (blue), respectively. The height of each bar corresponds to the negative log probability value; for example, the bar for “Cardio” reaches approximately -23.4, while the bar for “Pediatrics” reaches -26.1. All bars are presented without any visible sorting or emphasis.
